marketLayer.title: US Tech & Semiconductor Supply Chain
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology hyperscalers announced increased H2 AI infrastructure expenditure plans, driving a rally across semiconductor equipment manufacturers and custom chip designers.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained high capital expenditure by cloud giants provides strong earnings visibility for advanced packaging and high-bandwidth memory suppliers in the medium term.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential regulatory tightenings on AI technology export controls and extended payback timelines for enterprise AI investments.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & E-commerce Platforms
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index experienced sideways consolidation as leading Chinese e-commerce platforms stepped up promotional subsidies and price-matching initiatives.
marketLayer.inference: Near-term profitability margins for platform operators may face pressure, prioritizing market share defense over immediate operating margin expansion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Efficacy of subsidies in sustaining long-term user retention without continuous platform expenditure.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Expectations & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: US Treasury yields held steady following balanced labor market data and moderate inflation reads, maintaining market expectations for a rate cut in Q3.
marketLayer.inference: A stabilizing interest rate backdrop supports valuation multiples for high-growth tech equities and eases capital outflow pressures from emerging and HK markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Commodity price volatility and potential supply chain disruptions reigniting core PCE inflation factors.

marketLayer.title: China New Energy Vehicles (NEVs) & Automotive Sector
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed Chinese EV manufacturers reported improved month-over-month delivery volumes, boosted by nationwide vehicle trade-in policy incentives.
marketLayer.inference: Consumer demand stimulus is accelerating market concentration toward top-tier brands with strong cost-control and supply chain capabilities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Ongoing trade policy frictions and potential tariff adjustments in European and North American target markets.
